laws.rule: Private cars, rental cars and motorbikes may not drive into Kamikochi through the Kama Tunnel at any time of year; only buses, taxis and bicycles may enter while the road is open, and the road closes completely in winter. From the Matsumoto side, park at Sawando and take the shuttle bus or a fixed-fare taxi.
laws.heading: 長野県 上高地交通規制

laws.rule: Nagano Prefecture accommodation tax from stays on 1 June 2026: JPY 200 a person a night until 31 May 2029 (about A$1.80), then JPY 300 (about A$2.71) (RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = JPY 110.82). No tax under a room-only rate of JPY 6,000 (about A$54.14). Covers hotels, ryokan, simple lodgings and minpaku. Matsumoto, Karuizawa, Achi, Hakuba and Nozawa Onsen add their own municipal tax, so the amount there differs.
laws.heading: 長野県宿泊税条例

laws.rule: Under the Nagano Prefecture Mountain Climbing Safety Ordinance, anyone walking a designated trail (mountains the prefecture rates at higher risk of accidents) must lodge a climbing plan with the prefecture first: online through Nagano e-application, at a trailhead box, or by post. This applies even when joining the trail partway or crossing from a neighbouring prefecture.

festivals.what: Onbashira Festival (Suwa Taisha): held every seventh year counted inclusively, in the years of the tiger and the monkey; the next is 2028 (a monkey year). The Kami-sha Yamadashi (bringing the logs down the mountain) is in early April, followed by the Satobiki (hauling into the shrines). Large crowds around Lake Suwa.
